newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil down on futures dive.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil down on futures dive.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Thursday, traders said
Gas oil shed $1.25 a tonne across the board on easier futures. Refinery heating oil barges moved at $0.50 over July, unchanged.
Gasoline was steady to a touch firmer, but business was quiet with buyers and sellers several dollars apart.

High sulphur fuel oil barges were steady with low demand said to be barring the market from moving higher. The barges traded between $84 and $85 fob ARA, following early offers at $86, or $1 over Wednesday's close.
Low sulphur barges were steady on the offer side at $97 but buyers moved up $1 to $96.
High sulphur cargoes were quiet with a few buyers heard to be on the market and not too many avails around.
